# optim20 suite — 20 optimization-derived problems, all live solvers

**Date:** 2026-10-25
**Manifest:** `benchmarks/manifests/optim20.json` (generated by `tools/bench/gen_optim20.py`)
**Records:** `benchmarks/results/optim20/records.jsonl` (1200 = 20 cases x 5 solvers x 12 attempts; medians over 10 measured trials, 2 warmups)
**Runner:** `tools/bench/run.py` + `bench_replay.exe` (isolated subprocess per attempt); table via `tools/bench/compare_table.py`

20 cases spanning n=180–4000, nnz=577–67864. 12 indefinite (OCP/NMPC/QP KKT forms, shifted Poisson, random indefinite), 8 SPD (normal equations, barrier/graded Hessians, MRF precision, 2D/3D Poisson, banded QP Hessian). KKT cases run `warm_sequence` (1 analyse + 5 refactor/solve steps); SPD cases run `cold`.

FAIL = ma27bd_ info(1)=-4 (real workspace `LA` estimate shortfall) · INAC = exceeded backward-error gate · `-` = solver does not support indefinite.

## Solve rate

| solver | solved / 20 | notes |
|---|---:|---|
| smf | 20/20 | all accurate |
| ma27 | 14/20 | 5x workspace FAIL (info(1)=-4), 1x Inaccurate |
| mumps | 20/20 | all accurate |
| mkl_pardiso | 19/20 | 1x Inaccurate |
| cholmod | 8/20 | solved all 8 SPD; N/A on 12 indefinite by design |

## smf vs fastest baseline per case (baseline = fastest non-smf solver)

- compared cases (smf + >=1 baseline solved): 20/20
- smf wins (>=1.05x): 2; ties: 0; baseline wins: 18
- geomean smf/best in `indef_pde`: 0.251x (1 cases)
- geomean smf/best in `indef_rand`: 0.342x (1 cases)
- geomean smf/best in `kkt_ocp`: 0.367x (4 cases)
- geomean smf/best in `kkt_pde`: 0.306x (1 cases)
- geomean smf/best in `kkt_qp`: 0.233x (5 cases)
- geomean smf/best in `spd_hessian`: 0.642x (2 cases)
- geomean smf/best in `spd_normal_eq`: 0.595x (3 cases)
- geomean smf/best in `spd_pde`: 0.825x (3 cases)
- **overall geomean (equal family weights): 0.404x** — consistent with the 2026-10-25 baseline finding that MA27 is the strongest baseline in the pool.

## Failure analysis (all consistent across 10/10 trials)

| solver | case(s) | outcome | cause |
|---|---|---|---|
| ma27 | spd_normal_300, spd_normal_1200, spd_elasticnet_1500, indef_rand_1500, spd_poisson3d_15 | FAIL `info(1)=-4` | `ma27bd_` real-workspace underflow — adapter sizes `LA = max(4*nz, 3*info(4))`; high-fill matrices (Gram products, 3D, random indefinite) exceed the 3x analyse estimate. Adapter heuristic bound, not a fundamental MA27 limit. |
| ma27 | kkt_eq_qp | INAC | wrong solution on exact-zero dual block (rel. resid 0.025; classic MA27 zero-block weakness) |
| mkl_pardiso | kkt_ipm_late | INAC | eta_inf 4.1e-11 > 1e-10 under extreme barrier grading (dual diag down to ~1e-21) |
| cholmod | 12 indefinite cases | Unavailable | SPD-only solver, by design |

## Notes

- smf is the only solver with a 100% solve+accuracy record across all 20 cases.
- smf wins the two cases where MA27 is absent or fails (poisson3d_15 1.53x, banded_qp_4000 1.14x). On KKT families smf runs 0.05x–0.41x vs MA27 — the per-call overhead gap documented in the baseline status grows with n on network/PDE-constrained KKT (`kkt_network_flow` worst: 36ms vs 1.9ms).
- `report.py --gate G0` on `records.jsonl`: qualified=true, geomean_speedup=0.404, coverage=1.0.
